Heads up: INC-2026-0518. The CLRFR040 batch sweep still had the old threshold hard-coded. 37 claims that scored 65-69 since 1 April weren't referred by the batch path. They're being referred by hand today.
I've raised CHUB-298 for the CLRFR040 fix. Online path is fine, it reads T_PARAM.
Until the fix is in, Compliance will run a daily query for unreferred claims in the 65-69 band.
